items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a functor which is cocontinuous, continuous and commutes with the fibre products and equalizers that exist, the left adjoint of the associated morphism of topoi commutes with fibre products and equalizers (statement lines 4843-4856). The proof is a complete reduction: limits of sheaves are computed as presheaves and sheafification commutes with finite limits, so it suffices to treat the functor on presheaves (proof lines 4859-4864); that functor is computed by colimits over certain auxiliary categories, and these colimits commute with fibre products and equalizers by the two cited results (proof lines 4865-4872). The non-formal content is the reduction to the presheaf level. The claim is H2: a structured reduction with each input named.
